method: Emulation pauses during Jev inference. Jev chooses lane/tier and A/B. A visible-sprite adapter and frame-level actuator apply those choices in empirically calibrated JUST windows (lower cube y=177, upper cube y=141). Corner presses align to a calibrated 60-frame beat phase after the visible warning, allowing different warning lead times. A one-frame move away is used when a fresh positional input is needed. Judgments are reconstructed from the most frequent settled HUD score for each chain and validated against point increments; partial digit writes are excluded. No score, gauge, chart, or judgment-window memory is modified. This is assisted frame-stepped play, not real-time model reflexes.

attempts.limitation: Fixed corner lead missed a shorter warning.
